papers.markingGuideNote: The scheme awards attempt marks of 2 for a 5-mark step. Deduct 3 for a mathematical error, or 1 for a numerical slip or minor misreading. A serious error that oversimplifies the task receives attempt marks only. Valid alternative methods are accepted. Do not deduct an error twice.
papers.boundaryReview: Q2(a)(i) the collision proof and time remain one marked calculation: the scheme provides a common position equation, its time solution and a final clock time. Q2(b)(i) magnitude and direction have separate final 5-mark placements, so magnitude includes the preparatory vector step (10) and direction has 5. Q4(b)(i) has two separate 5-mark force diagrams; in (ii) the time is not separately priced and the final x step completes a joint 20-mark task. Q7(a)(i) distances from AD and AB have separate 5-mark placements, with shared area work attached to AD (10) and AB (5). Q7(b)(i) the two diagrams each receive 5, and (iii) magnitude and direction each receive 5. Q9(a) densities are the two roots of one quadratic, jointly awarded the final 5-mark placement. Q10(b)(i) both times similarly share one final 5-mark placement. No finite answer-option pools occur; hence or otherwise permits alternative methods only.
